title: Inside the shared packages (packages/*)
caption: One group per package; nodes are the source files that matter when you fix something. `src/generated/` files are written by generators, never by hand.

nodes.label: define-config.ts / env.ts
nodes.detail: Reads `process.env` once, validates every builder, throws one `ConfigError` listing variable names, never values.

nodes.label: key-files.ts
nodes.detail: `readKeyFile`: regular file, mode without group/other bits, base64 or PEM, minimum bytes.

nodes.label: dev-env-files.ts
nodes.detail: `loadDevEnvFiles`: `<app>/.env.local` then root `.env.local`, only unset variables; no-op when `APP_ENV` or `NODE_ENV` is production.

nodes.label: create-logger.ts
nodes.detail: pino with `app`, `env`, ISO time, the `err` serializer (no bodies).

nodes.label: http.ts (pinoHttpOptions)
nodes.detail: Keeps a valid `X-Request-Id` (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,128}$`) or makes a UUID; one line per request; skips `/health*`.

nodes.label: redact-paths.ts
nodes.detail: The single redaction list, shallow to deep; card objects censored to depth 8.

nodes.label: redact-payload.ts / mask.ts
nodes.detail: Deep copy for persisted payloads: card number → last 4, CVC dropped, tokens `[REDACTED]`; `maskPan` keeps BIN + last 4; `holdsCardNumber` (card-number.ts) says whether a free text holds a card number.

nodes.label: envelope.ts
nodes.detail: AES-256-GCM value + wrapped DEK; version byte 1; 98 bytes overhead for `local:v1`.

nodes.label: local-file-key-provider.ts
nodes.detail: Loads every `master-v<N>.key` as KEK `local:v<N>`; refuses loose modes and wrong lengths.

nodes.label: aad.ts
nodes.detail: `<schema>.<table>.<column>:<rowId>`.

nodes.label: rewrap-batch.ts
nodes.detail: Keyset-paged re-wrap with an optimistic update per row; reports `remainingByKekId`.

nodes.label: tokens.ts / hash.ts / signed-url.ts / ids.ts
nodes.detail: `generateToken`, `sha256Hex`, `hashApiKey` (pepper), `signUrl`/`verifySignedUrl`, `newId` (ULID, never monotonic).

nodes.label: pool.ts / type-parsers.ts
nodes.detail: `createPool`: 10 connections, 30 s session statement_timeout; numeric/int8 as strings, timestamptz as Date.

nodes.label: platform-db.ts
nodes.detail: Kysely over `platform.*` and `reference.*` by qualified name.

nodes.label: tenant-db.ts / tenant-schema.ts
nodes.detail: `tenantTx`: validate schema name, leak guard, `set_config('search_path', '<schema>, reference', true)`, timeout 5 s.

nodes.label: migrate/*.ts + cli/migrate.ts
nodes.detail: Files, ledger, repeatable grants, tenant schema runner, fan-out; exit codes 0/1/2/3.

nodes.label: storage/local-disk-storage.ts
nodes.detail: Atomic writes, mode 0600, key rules `tenant_<key>/…` or `platform/…`; `s3` not implemented.

nodes.label: src/generated/{platform,reference,tenant}.ts
nodes.detail: Kysely table types from `pnpm db:codegen`.

nodes.label: app-error.ts / envelope.ts
nodes.detail: `AppError(code)`, `toErrorEnvelope`, `FIELD_ERROR_CODES`.

nodes.label: src/generated/catalogue.ts
nodes.detail: Generated from both documents' `x-error-catalogue`.

nodes.label: src/generated/{ota,platform,operations}.ts
nodes.detail: openapi-typescript 7 output and the operations index.

nodes.label: src/jobs/*.ts
nodes.detail: Queue names, `tenant.*` messages, `vx:invalidate` events, `validateJob`, `validateInvalidation`.

nodes.label: scripts/generate.mjs, contracts-lint.mjs
nodes.detail: `pnpm contracts:generate` and `pnpm contracts:lint`.

nodes.label: test-database.ts / vitest-global-setup.ts
nodes.detail: Template per run, clone per file, forced drop.

nodes.label: redis.ts, clock.ts, builders.ts, openapi-response.ts
nodes.detail: `useRedis` (DB 1–15), `FakeClock`, `defineBuilder`, Ajv response check.

nodes.label: mailpit.ts, amadeus.ts, stripe.ts
nodes.detail: `waitForMessage`, `startAmadeusStub`, `signedStripeEvent`.

nodes.label: process.env + .env.local
nodes.detail: Systemd env files on the VM; `.env.local` locally.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16
nodes.detail: Roles `velexis_migrator`, `velexis_provisioner`, `velexis_platform_app`, `velexis_ota_app` (+ `velexis_test_admin` locally/CI).

nodes.label: OpenAPI documents
nodes.detail: `ota/backend/openapi/…`, `platform/backend/openapi/…`

nodes.label: Key files
nodes.detail: `/etc/velexis/keys/<zone>/` (VM) or `.local/keys/` (dev).
